evidence.result: The verified policy declares two Body sources. The consumer reads each through Reader.source and unions only names in the component collection with exact body/ prefix. Every declared source is read; a missing extension propagates failure instead of preserving an initial-only PASS.
body.data is preserved, body.data_sources includes initial and extension JSON exactly once, and amendment path is explicit.
Tests accept each of the19 new role names and assert FileNotFoundError when extension file is absent. Existing component-token preservation and readback cases also remain covered.
